reason: report 5d8ce8ce ("AI Chat and AI Feed buttons ... appear bigger and rounder"). MEASURED live at 375px: group 200x52, each segment 44x44, against the frame's own 200x32 (p-1 + py-1 + 16px line = 32, per AiHomeToggle.geometry.test.tsx). Cause: each segment is a real <button> and src/index.css's mobile touch floor (`button:not(.no-min-size)`, min-height 44px under 768px) had no opt-out here. Fixed 5e6a18654: added `no-min-size` to AiHome.tsx's segmentClass, matching the opt-out pattern HomeSidebarExpanded already uses for its own under-44 rows. "Rounder" is the same defect: a taller pill on an unchanged corner radius reads rounder. 2 new tests in AiHomeToggle.touchFloor.test.tsx, confirmed red on the un-fixed source and green after; AiHomeToggle.geometry.test.tsx (2 tests) unaffected.

report 2e45a08d ("Chat box in app appears too tall compared to figma"). MEASURED live at 375px: card 152px tall against the frame's 112 (6419:45467 = 2*16 pad + 16 line + 32 gap + 32 action row, per AskComposer.geometry.test.tsx). Cause: the prompt field is a real <textarea> and the +/mic/send controls are real <button>s; src/index.css floors both element kinds to 44px under 768px with no opt-out here, so the field measured 44 (not 16) and the action row 44 (not 32) - 152-112=40 and (44-16)+(44-32)=40, i.e. the floor is the entire overage. Fixed 5d3899cb1: `no-min-size` on the field and all three buttons (attach, voice/stop-recording, send). 4 new tests in AskComposer.touchFloor.test.tsx, confirmed red before/green after; AskComposer.geometry.test.tsx (4 tests) unaffected.

report deeaf457 ("Unable to exit or press/tap out of screen when there are words inside chat box. Only lets you out once all text is deleted"). REPRODUCED live: the hero's full-viewport dim/blur scrim (this frame's Overlay node) stays up while `composerFocused || draft.length > 0` - the OR is deliberate, so a click into the composer's own +/mic controls doesn't drop the spotlight - but the scrim has no way to tell that click apart from a tap meant to leave, and it sits above the header, sidebar hamburger and bottom nav, so with any typed text every one of those taps was swallowed and did nothing; the only escape was deleting the whole draft by hand. Fixed 5e6a18654: a tap directly ON the scrim (unambiguous - nothing else lives there) sets `spotlightDismissed`, which `focusActive` now honours regardless of the draft, until the field is focused again. 3 new tests in AiHome.spotlightDismiss.test.tsx, confirmed red before/green after, including a regression check that blurring into a composer control still keeps the spotlight up. Report 40dc8bed ("No Blur Background") targets the SAME overlay/frame and was NOT reproduced: `backdrop-blur-md` over `bg-black/40` has been live since 0aaac2dd0 (2026-07-17, report 2a00fcf4) and is pinned by AiHome.focusBackdropBlur.test.tsx (3/3 green, unaffected by this pass's edits); closed with a request for a fresh screenshot if still seen live.

report 223ba3fa ("Folders option that is shown in figma image does not appear in app"). This frame ("Home - sidebar normal > Group chats > Folder name", the "Create new chat folder" modal) IS reachable and matches: long-press (or right-click) a chat row -> multi-select -> "Group chats in folder" opens exactly this dialog. Mobile reachability was hardened in b52d639b6 (report 104e209d) because iOS never dispatches `contextmenu`; re-verified this pass via HomeSidebarExpanded.chatLongPress.test.tsx, 7/7 green, no code change needed. PARTIAL because the underlying complaint - no VISIBLE affordance for folders anywhere in the base sidebar view - is real and matches a gap in the Figma source itself: the kebab deliberately omits a "Group in folder" row (2720:8186 draws none) and no baseline frame draws a persistent "New folder" button either, so the app is Figma-literal, not broken. Posted as a product question rather than closed silently: keep it gesture-only (matches Figma, no change) or add a discoverable entry point Figma does not currently draw.
